items.title: Add to Favorites
items.description: Rare and extraordinary multigenerational compound on 11+ acres in the heart of Central Whidbey Island — where two beautifully appointed residences, endless outdoor amenities, and a lifetime of possibilities come together in one truly remarkable package. Two completely separate residences, each with their own private entrance, are thoughtfully connected by an enchanting enclosed garden and gazebo area complete with an outdoor kitchen — the perfect setting for al fresco entertaining and the ideal balance of togetherness & independence. The newly updated 1958 home honors its character with modern comfort, while the stunning 2022 residence showcases live edge Douglas Fir finishes and exterior wood milled directly from the property itself — a level of craftsmanship and authenticity that simply cannot be replicated. Above the barn, a light-filled artist studio, a fenced garden, chicken coop, fruit trees, & a versatile barn with endless possibilities complete a property that feels like its own private world. Partial water views & over 11 acres of lush land deliver the space, privacy, & freedom that define Whidbey Island living at its finest. Whether you envision a multigenerational retreat, working hobby farm, artist's haven, or a private sanctuary — this home delivers on every front. Includes 2 buildable lots in the Crockett Lake community. Gems like this simply do not come around often. Also see listing #2554897 which does NOT include the 2 additional building lots.

Whidbey Island Real Estate
Irene Echenique is a real estate agent with Windermere on Whidbey Island, WA.  
View listings
SERVICES
Selling Whidbey Island Real Estate
THINK ABOUT THIS: YOU’RE A KEY PART IN HELPING SOMEONE’S NEXT CHAPTER BEGIN. So how do we get started? First, let’s meet and get to know one another. I want to know all about what you’re hoping for and your past experiences (if any) with selling. After we meet, the next step is a Market Analysis. I’ll take a quick tour of your home then get to work on crunching data and doing research. I’ll come back with options for what I think we can sell your home for (I never provide just one number).
SERVICES
Buying Whidbey Island Real Estate
First things first, let’s meet and get to know one another. I want to know all about why you’re moving to Whidbey and how you envision your dream home as I get to know your timeline for moving forward. Pre approval is always the first step. We’ll discuss your lender, on-island lender choices, and why it matters so much. Now for the fun part: your ideal home. Likes. Dislikes. Absolute must-haves. We’ll discuss the current market, location, schools, and everything Whidbey Island has to offer.
THE AREA
Clinton
Zipcode: 98236 Discovering Clinton takes you on an adventure through rural back roads with surprises and beauty around every corner. This vibrant historical community has been around since the early 1800’s and has always been a travel destination. Clinton is located at the entrance of Whidbey Island and is the beginning of Whidbey Isle Scenic Byway as well as the beginning of the North Cascade Loop. View Clinton, WA waterfront homes for sale

I look at the process as a collaborative effort so I’ll keep you prepped and informed at every juncture. A proud New York native living on Whidbey Island, I have a “no BS” approach when I work with clients.

YOUR INTRODUCTION
With nearly two decades immersed in real estate, I’ve made Whidbey Island my home—and my passion. I believe in a ‘no BS’ approach: honest advice, unwavering support, and always keeping you informed. Raised in New York and seasoned by Wall Street, I blend business acumen with neighborhood spirit, bringing you not just market expertise but genuine local insight. My clients know me as a clear communicator and dedicated advocate, ready to help you navigate the emotional and financial journeys of home buying or selling. My family and I adore island life, and I can’t wait to share the community with you.
